candidates.statement: Redis reserve_inventory operations time out (~2s), causing inventory POST /v1/reservations to fail with 503, order POST /v1/orders to fail with 502 ReadTimeout, and gateway POST /v1/checkout to return 502. Traces show redis.reserve_inventory DependencyUnavailable timeouts across all correlated requests.
candidates.uncertainty: No redis-side metrics/logs; root cause of the redis timeout (load, saturation, network) is not established.

report.explanation: Checkout 502s align with ~2s timeouts propagating from redis.reserve_inventory through inventory (503) and order (502) to gateway. Traces, logs, metrics and topology consistently support a redis-timeout root cause; no counter-evidence present.
missing_evidence: Redis server-side metrics/logs showing latency or saturation during the incident window
Inventory service logs confirming redis dependency failure timing
